QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Unexpected Welcome
QuestInfo.0: Contrary to your expectations, Skuas welcomes you and offers shelter for the young and the wounded. But the broken castle walls set the people murmuring anxiously about how safe it really is.
